description: Post-Kahan-patch get_r pathology probe. For each seed, runs BKZ/SD-BKZ at (n=100, β=30, q=3329, MPFR=1000 bits, 40 tours) against fplll+fpylll rebuilt with patches/fplll_gso_kahan.patch applied, and watches whether fplll's MatGSO::get_r ever returns a non-positive value (the signature of the Cholesky-style squared-form GSO cancellation documented in paper §8).
claim_backed: Paper §8 Section 'Mitigation and Upstream Context': 'A Kahan-compensated subtraction patch ... reduces the degeneracy rate from 38.0% (38/100 unpatched) to 0% (0/55 patched seeds at the same parameters)'. This file evidences the 0/55 half of the claim.
classifier: degeneracy defined as fplll get_r(i,i) returning a non-positive value at any tour for any i. 0/55 seeds hit this condition; compare to 38/100 (38%) unpatched (q3329_degeneracy_check.json).
